aboutPage.intro: Hi! I'm Lorenzo Censi, {{age}} years old, and I love experimenting with the web and videogames.
aboutPage.webText: I design and build modern sites using React and Drupal.
aboutPage.gameText: In my spare time I make prototypes with Unity and other technologies.
aboutPage.musicText: I listen to everything, from rock to synthwave
aboutPage.travelText: I love exploring new places and cultures
aboutPage.brainDescription: The control center where the craziest ideas are born. Processes coffee and code in industrial quantities, often at 3 AM.
aboutPage.eyesDescription: Silent witnesses to thousands of lines of code. They've seen errors, bugs, and that time I forgot a semicolon for 3 hours.
aboutPage.heartDescription: Beats for programming, accelerates when code works on the first try, stops when I see a merge conflict.
aboutPage.lungsDescription: Breathe clean code and sigh deeply with every refactoring. Have held their breath through too many production builds.
aboutPage.handsDescription: The real heroes of this story. They've typed, debugged, and thrown objects at the monitor (always without breaking it).
aboutPage.stomachDescription: Official converter of coffee to code. Has developed legendary caffeine tolerance and a cookie addiction.
aboutPage.liverDescription: The silent filter that purifies stress from impossible deadlines. Has developed super-powers to metabolize frustration.
aboutPage.kidneysDescription: Filter bad architectural decisions and maintain balance between optimism and realism in code.
aboutPage.spleenDescription: The most mysterious organ, which accumulates all the repressed anger when code doesn't compile. Has perfect memory of every stupid mistake.
aboutPage.ribcageDescription: The support structure that protects everything else. Like code architecture, if it fails everything goes to pieces.
aboutPage.skullDescription: The fortress that protects the brain from external blows. Has withstood infinite head-banging against the wall when code wouldn't work.
aboutPage.teethDescription: Survival tools that chew through complex problems. Have bitten the tongue too many times during intense debugging sessions.
